note: Curated free-licence stock clips for Reels (QUEUE G17, OWNER D38). tools/social-reels.mjs draws a clip only when status is "approved", the licence name is in ALLOWED_LICENCES, and its place equals the entry's place exactly (an event's city); a clip with item_ids is used only for those items, a clip without item_ids must be a neutral view of the city (never a different event). Approve a clip only after watching the chosen segment (start_s, duration_s): no identifiable faces as the subject, no logos or promotional art as the subject, really the named place, and the licence still shown on the source page. Credit is drawn on the frames and added to the caption. Pexels entries (provider "pexels", licence "Pexels License", https://www.pexels.com/license/) can be added the same way once we have an API key; nothing here calls an API.
